title: Product Owner - Sênior
description:
Product Owner - Sênior

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.


Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.


Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

No seu dia a dia, você gerenciará o backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base no valor para o negócio, impacto operacional e necessidades regulatórias. Atuará como principal interlocutor entre as áreas de negócio (operações, comercial, regulatório, supply chain) e os times de desenvolvimento, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em requisitos técnicos claros e viáveis. Você liderará cerimônias ágeis e garantirá a entrega contínua de valor, promovendo melhorias incrementais nos processos de distribuição de gás. Além disso, acompanhará métricas de desempenho do produto (KPIs de negócio e de uso), proporá evoluções baseadas em dados e feedback dos usuários, e garantirá que as soluções desenvolvidas estejam em conformidade com as normas de segurança e regulação do setor de gás.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Gerenciar o backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base no valor para o negócio, impacto operacional e necessidades regulatórias.
  • Atuar como principal interlocutor(a) entre áreas de negócio (operações, comercial, regulatório e supply chain) e os times de desenvolvimento, traduzindo necessidades em requisitos técnicos claros e viáveis.
  • Liderar cerimônias ágeis e garantir a entrega contínua de valor para o produto.
  • Promover melhorias incrementais nos processos de distribuição de gás.
  • Acompanhar métricas de desempenho (KPIs de negócio e de uso), analisando dados para direcionar evoluções do produto.
  • Propor melhorias com base em dados e feedbacks dos usuários.
  • Garantir que as soluções estejam em conformidade com normas de segurança e regulação do setor.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Visão holística e estratégica, com capacidade de compreender o negócio de distribuição de gás de ponta a ponta, conectando iniciativas de tecnologia às metas do negócio.
  • Perfil de liderança com forte viés de execução, sendo “mão na massa”, orientado(a) a resultados e capaz de remover impedimentos para garantir entregas com qualidade e agilidade.
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade de transitar entre áreas, atuando como ponte entre negócio e tecnologia.
  • Sólido conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) e práticas de gestão de produto (roadmaps, OKRs, MVPs).
  • Experiência na liderança de squads multidisciplinares e atuação em ciclos de discovery e delivery.
  • Formação superior em Administração, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Possuir pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Negócios, Energia ou Transformação Digital.
  • Tiver certificações em Product Ownership (CSPO, PSPO) e metodologias ágeis (CSM, SAFe).
  • Tiver familiaridade com o setor de gás e energia, incluindo regulação da ANP e processos como medição, faturamento, logística e segurança operacional.
  • Demonstrar forte visão sistêmica e pensamento crítico.
  • Apresentar habilidade de negociação e influência.
  • Ser resiliente e adaptável em ambientes de alta complexidade.
  • Ter perfil colaborativo e facilitador.
  • Demonstrar orientação a resultados e senso de urgência.
  • Possuir experiência em contextos dinâmicos.

Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

The AI Agent Manager serves as the key technical and strategic resource for the company’s AI applications, with a focus on designing, building, operating, and managing complex AI agents. title: Salesforce System Analyst
description:
Job Title: Salesforce System Analyst

Location: Brazil

Duration: 6-12 months with possible extension or FTE conversion


Introduction:

We are seeking a skilled Salesforce System Analyst with 5 to 10 years of experience to join our dynamic team. This role is critical in driving the optimization and enhancement of our Sales Cloud platform, ensuring seamless Salesforce migration , effective Salesforce administration , and robust system configuration and implementation . The Salesforce System Analyst will play a pivotal role in aligning our CRM capabilities with business goals, improving sales processes, and enabling data-driven decision-making across the organization.


Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Lead and manage end-to-end Salesforce migration projects, ensuring data integrity and minimal disruption to business operations.
  • Perform comprehensive Salesforce administration tasks, including user management, security settings, and system maintenance.
  • Configure and customize Sales Cloud features to meet evolving business requirements, including workflows, validation rules, and custom objects.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, analyze business processes, and translate them into scalable technical solutions within Salesforce .
  • Drive the implementation of new Salesforce functionalities and third-party integrations to enhance system capabilities.
  • Monitor system performance and troubleshoot issues to maintain optimal platform efficiency.
  • Develop and maintain detailed documentation related to system configurations, processes, and best practices.
  • Provide training and support to end-users to maximize adoption and utilization of Salesforce tools.
  • Stay updated on the latest Salesforce releases and industry trends to recommend innovative solutions.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 5 to 10 years of proven experience as a Salesforce System Analyst or similar role.
  • Salesforce certifications such as Salesforce Administrator (ADM 201) , Salesforce Platform App Builder , or relevant advanced certifications are highly desirable.
  • Strong understanding of Sales Cloud functionalities and CRM best practices.
  • Demonstrated experience in Salesforce migration , administration, configuration , and implementation projects.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple priorities.


Tools and Technologies:

  • Salesforce Sales Cloud
  • Salesforce Administration tools and features
  • Salesforce Migration tools (e.g., Data Loader, Salesforce DX)
  • Salesforce Configuration and Customization tools (Workflows, Process Builder, Flow Builder)
  • Integration tools (e.g., MuleSoft, REST/SOAP APIs)

  • Version control and collaboration platforms (e.g., Git, Jira)


Skills:

Sales Cloud, Salesforce migration, Salesforce administration, Configuration, Implementation

title: Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
Company Description

Metrobi is a delivery fulfillment platform designed specifically to support local businesses. We help these businesses manage their deliveries efficiently by connecting them with skilled drivers tailored to meet their delivery needs. Additionally, we provide essential tools for logistical, financial, and marketing support, empowering local food and beverage makers to expand their businesses


Role of the QA Team:

Our QA team is crucial in ensuring the quality of our platform. There are two main tasks you will focus on:

  • Bug Analysis: Understand and diagnose bugs that make it into production. This requires a solid understanding of our product and excellent problem-solving skills.
  • Proactively finding issues that affect users: Identify parts of the system that need to be improved according to feedback coming from users and testing. You need to be able to clearly report the problem and propose a solution.
  • Feature Verification: Manually check whether new features work as intended. This involves strong analytical skills to assess user experience and interface design.


While specific technical skills like SQL, Git, reading Python code, and creating automated tests are very beneficial, they are not required.


We're looking for candidates with strong English, product usage analysis skills, and excellent communication. This is a full-time, Monday-to-Friday position, with working hours from 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM (Boston time), including a one-hour lunch break.

title: Data Engineer
description:
About FirstIgnite:

FirstIgnite builds best-in-class software that accelerates commercialization and innovation by connecting scientific research with industry partners. We support universities, national labs, and research hospitals worldwide with tools that simplify complex science and identify real partnership opportunities.


Role Overview:

The Data Engineer will lead the design, development, and maintenance of scalable data systems that integrate diverse datasets. This role includes deploying AI and machine learning solutions to enhance insights, manage complex data relationships, and drive actionable intelligence for FirstIgnite’s platform. You will mentor and manage a team of data engineers while working cross-functionally to innovate and deliver impactful AI-driven solutions.


Responsibilities :

  • Lead the architecture, development, and optimization of scalable data pipelines for patents, grants, clinical trials, publications, labs, and firmographic sources.
  • Build and maintain ETL workflows on AWS using Glue (PySpark), Lambda, S3, and RDS PostgreSQL.
  • Explore and implement complementary data storage solutions as needed.
  • Apply machine learning and LLM-based techniques to extract, structure, and enrich data at scale.
  • Ensure data integrity, security, accuracy, and governance across all systems.
  • Implement tools for data exploration, visualization, and actionable insights.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to drive AI-driven innovation.
  • Evaluate emerging AI/ML techniques and tools to enhance platform capabilities.
  • Maintain version control, CI/CD pipelines, and reproducible workflows for the data engineering team.


Requirements :

  • Strong programming expertise in Python, with experience building production data pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS data services (Glue/PySpark, Lambda, S3, RDS PostgreSQL, SSM) or equivalent cloud data stacks.
  • Familiarity with RESTful and GraphQL APIs, ETL processes, and data integration strategies.
  • Understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and AI-enhanced data applications.
  • Strong analytical skills, including evaluating trade-offs of data ingestion and storage methods.
  • Leadership experience managing data engineering or AI teams in SaaS or tech environments.
  • Solid knowledge of version control (Git) and CI/CD practices.
  • Exposure to data science / ML libraries (Pandas, Scikit-learn, PyTorch) and managed ML platforms (SageMaker, Vertex AI) is a plus.
  • Excellent problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills in cross-functional teams.

Role Overview

We are seeking an expert-level, highly skilled Cloud Systems Engineer (DevOps) to serve as a GCP Specialist and technical builder for our Google Cloud ecosystem. This role requires more than administration; you must be capable of building architectural change, adjusting systems, and driving modernization efforts. You will be responsible for the end-to-end management of our GCP infrastructure, from complex networking to proactive cost optimization and resource scaling. A key responsibility is leading and running large-scale cloud migration projects, specifically from AWS to GCP.


The ideal candidate ensures our Compute Engine environment is lean, fast, and resilient while maintaining secure connectivity using both native and third-party VPN solutions.

The role’s primary focus demands deep GCP expertise, but candidates must also possess significant experience with AWS for successful migration

strategy.


Key Responsibilities

  • Infrastructure & Networking: Configure and maintain robust networking architectures, including Cloud DNS and Cloud NAT.
  • Linux System Administration: Manage and maintain the operating system environment on Compute Engine instances, including patching, configuration management, user account management, and troubleshooting core system issues.
  • VPN Management: Build and manage secure tunnels using Cloud VPN , pfSense virtual appliances, and CloudConnexa (OpenVPN) for flexible remote access.
  • Performance Monitoring: Utilize Google Cloud Operations Suite to monitor Compute Engine health. Identify bottlenecks and tune instances for peak performance.
  • Resource Management: Oversee persistent disks, snapshots, and storage buckets. Ensure high availability while purging unused resources to maintain environment hygiene.
  • Cost Optimization: Actively monitor billing dashboards, implement committed use discounts (CUDs), and right-size underutilized instances to maintain a lean budget.
  • Database Oversight: Provide support for PostgreSQL and Oracle environments, ensuring seamless integration and performance within the GCP ecosystem.
  • Security & Compliance : Enforce IAM roles and security best practices to protect the project perimeter


Required Qualifications

  • Certification: Active Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer certification.
  • Containerization Mastery: Strong expertise with Docker for containerizing applications, managing images, and troubleshooting container runtimes.
  • Scripting Mastery: High proficiency in Python or Bash for automating routine infrastructure tasks, reporting, and task scheduling.
  • Networking Expertise: Hands-on experience managing network routing, firewall rules, and site-to-site VPNs using pfSense and CloudConnexa.
  • Cloud Migration & Project Leadership: Proven experience leading and running application and data migrations from AWS to GCP. This includes the capability to own the end-to-end migration project life cycle and drive solutions.
  • Compute Engine Mastery: Deep understanding of VM lifecycles, custom machine types, and auto-scaling.
  • English Proficiency: Advanced English level (B2–C1 or higher)


Nice-to-Have

  • PostgreSQL Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with configuration, optimization, and query tuning.
  • Oracle Expertise: Experience managing or migrating Oracle database environments.
  • Data & Analytics: Familiarity with BigQuery.


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

title: AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
About FirstIgnite

FirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack.

We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production.


The Role

We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse.

This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company.


What You'll Do

  • Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents.
  • Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes (\"does this surface the right principal investigator?\") into precise, measurable rubrics.
  • Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests.
  • Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch.
  • Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality.
  • Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion.
  • Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.


Requirements

  • 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in-house tooling.
  • Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them.
  • Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked.
  • Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week.
  • Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don't trust or read the results.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents.
  • Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi-step, tool-using systems.
  • Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research-adjacent domain.
  • Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non-engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.


Why This Role

  • You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define.
  • AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue.
  • Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring.
  • Direct access to real-world, high-stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy.


This is a fully remote position. We have engineers across the Americas, Europe, and Africa. Overlap with US working hours is expected.

Diferenciais

title: Quality Assurence
description:
Estamos buscando profissionais de QA com forte atuação funcional e suporte técnico em automação.


Buscamos profissionais para atuação em qualidade ponta a ponta , com foco em validação funcional, geração de evidências e rastreabilidade das entregas em um ecossistema com microserviços, integrações e múltiplos meios de pagamento .


Essa posição tem foco funcional, porém exige conhecimento obrigatório em JavaScript e Playwright , para apoiar validações técnicas, ajustes de fluxo e interpretações de respostas de APIs quando necessário.


Você fará parte de um time orientado à excelência em qualidade, atuando de forma próxima aos times de desenvolvimento, produto e operações.


Responsabilidades


  • Participar de refinamentos, entendimento de regras de negócio e definição de critérios de aceite.
  • Planejar, executar e evidenciar testes funcionais ponta a ponta.
  • Criar e manter cenários e casos de teste com rastreabilidade no Jira/Xray , utilizando BDD com Gherkin (uso obrigatório) .
  • Executar testes de regressão, testes exploratórios e suporte a UAT/homologação.
  • Validar integrações e fluxos críticos envolvendo APIs, microserviços, mensageria (SQS), ERP e meios de pagamento (Pix, Boleto e Cartão) .
  • Acompanhar incidentes/bugs, apoiar priorização e realizar retestes.
  • Garantir rastreabilidade entre requisito ↔ teste ↔ evidência ↔ defeito .
  • Implementar testes e ajustes utilizando Playwright .
  • Apoiar validações técnicas com JavaScript (ex.: lógica de validação, estruturação de payloads, análise de respostas de APIs, interpretação de objetos JSON e pequenos scripts de apoio).


Requisitos Obrigatórios


  • Experiência com testes funcionais e processos de qualidade em ambientes ágeis.
  • Vivência com sistemas distribuídos e integrações (APIs/microserviços).
  • Experiência com validação de APIs via Postman ou Insomnia .
  • Experiência com Jira e Xray .
  • Uso obrigatório de BDD com Gherkin para criação e manutenção de cenários.
  • Boa escrita de cenários, critérios de aceite e documentação de evidências.
  • Experiência com testes de regressão e priorização de cenários críticos.
  • Conhecimento obrigatório em JavaScript (não atuará como QE, mas precisa interpretar, ajustar e criar pequenos trechos de código).
  • Experiência sólida com Playwright (locators, interações, assertions, waits, screenshots e vídeos).
  • Experiência com CI/CD e execução de testes em pipelines (ex.: Jenkins) .
  • Conhecimento em Docker e ambientes conteinerizados.


Diferenciais


  • Noções de observabilidade (Dynatrace, Loki).
  • Experiência com jornadas de Checkout e Pagamentos (Pix, boleto, cartão) .
  • Noções de segurança/controles (ex.: PCI) aplicados a testes.
  • Conhecimento básico em AWS ou ambientes cloud (multi-account) .


Sobre a OSF Digital


A OSF Digital tem orgulho de ser uma empresa que oferece oportunidades iguais, onde você pode ser você mesmo no trabalho. Junte-se a uma comunidade inclusiva e apaixonada de profissionais que ajudam a promover a transformação digital para empresas ao redor do mundo.

Na OSF Digital, acolhemos todas as pessoas e não discriminamos com base em identidade e expressão de gênero, raça, etnia, deficiência, orientação sexual, cor, religião, origem nacional, idade, estado civil ou qualquer outra categoria protegida em qualquer jurisdição onde atuamos.

title: Data Engineer III
description:
Posição temporária!


Visão Geral da Posição

A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está buscando um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de desempenho do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de infraestrutura de dados escalável e soluções de engenharia. A equipe trabalha em estreita colaboração com liderança, finanças, operações e stakeholders do negócio para viabilizar acesso confiável a dados de alta qualidade, apoiar análises avançadas e impulsionar ações orientadas por dados em toda a organização.

O(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados terá um papel crítico no desenho, construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados robustos, modelos de dados e ativos fundamentais que suportam analytics, relatórios e capacidades emergentes de IA/ML. Essa função exige forte rigor em engenharia, profundo entendimento de sistemas de dados e capacidade de colaborar entre equipes técnicas e de negócio.

O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui um histórico comprovado na construção de soluções de dados escaláveis em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, e sente-se confortável equilibrando trabalho em plataformas de dados fundamentais com iniciativas em evolução de analytics e IA.


O que você fará

Você possui uma forte mentalidade de engenharia e resolução de problemas. Converte necessidades de negócio e analíticas em soluções e arquiteturas de dados escaláveis e confiáveis.

Projeta, constrói e mantém pipelines e modelos de dados escaláveis que suportam monitoramento de desempenho do negócio, analytics e relatórios, além de contribuir para o desenvolvimento da Base de Dados BMP em ambientes Hive, Snowflake e data lakes.

Apoia o desenvolvimento de produtos e aplicações de dados, incluindo contribuição em pipelines baseados em Streamlit e no desenvolvimento de capacidades de chatbot para melhorar o acesso e a interação com dados.

Colabora de perto com equipes de analytics, ciência de dados e áreas de negócio para garantir disponibilidade, qualidade e usabilidade dos dados para dashboards, relatórios e análises avançadas.

Viabiliza e apoia o desenvolvimento de analytics avançado, machine learning e capacidades de IA, garantindo que a infraestrutura, pipelines e ambientes necessários estejam disponíveis para o desenvolvimento e implantação de modelos.

Contribui para o design e evolução do ecossistema de dados e ML, ajudando a estabelecer infraestrutura, processos e fundamentos necessários para escalar iniciativas de IA/ML na organização.


Qualificações Mínimas

• Mestrado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Dados, Engenharia ou área quantitativa relacionada.

• Mais de 5 anos de experiência em engenharia de dados, desenvolvimento de plataformas de dados ou funções relacionadas.

• Forte experiência com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação (Python ou equivalente).

• Familiaridade com frameworks de big data e processamento distribuído (ex.: Spark / PySpark).

• Experiência na construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados e trabalho com arquiteturas modernas de dados.

• Experiência com ferramentas de orquestração (ex.: Airflow) e automação de pipelines.

• Experiência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (ex.: AWS) e soluções de data warehouse (ex.: Snowflake).

• Sólido entendimento de modelagem de dados, qualidade de dados e governança de dados.

• Experiência com sistemas de controle de versão (Git) e fluxos colaborativos de desenvolvimento.

• Fortes habilidades de resolução de problemas e capacidade de trabalhar com requisitos ambíguos.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de colaborar com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.

• Inglês fluente.


Qualificações Desejáveis

• Experiência com arquiteturas de data lake e ambientes de dados híbridos.

• Experiência com suporte a pipelines e infraestrutura de machine learning.

• Experiência com aplicações de dados (ex.: Streamlit) e interfaces conversacionais (chatbots).

• Experiência com ferramentas e práticas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA.

• Experiência contribuindo para documentação e plataformas de compartilhamento de conhecimento (ex.: Confluence).

title: Account Manager
description:
As an Account Manager for Brazil , you'll join our passionate and supportive team characterised by our ambition and team spirit. You'll have the freedom to work independently while fostering strong collaboration with our content and product departments.


You'll be responsible for driving the entire sales and success cycle in the iGaming market, from initial engagement to maximizing long-term results. Managing key client relationships, driving sales growth, and ensuring customer satisfaction within these specific regions. This role requires a proactive approach to identifying opportunities, understanding client needs, and delivering tailored solutions that drive mutual success.


Specifically, your role will involve:


  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key clients, including sports betting operators, casinos, online gaming platforms, and other relevant stakeholders.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for key client accounts, managing all aspects of the client relationship and serving as their trusted advisor.
  • Understand clients' business objectives, market trends, and regulatory requirements specific to the English speaking markets to effectively position our gambling products and services.
  • Collaborate with internal sales, marketing, and product development teams to customize solutions and address client needs within these regions.
  • Proactively identify opportunities for upselling additional products/services and expanding client accounts.
  • Prepare and deliver compelling sales presentations, proposals, and business cases to key clients within these regions.
  • Monitor and analyze sales performance, market trends, and competitor activities to identify opportunities for growth and optimization within key accounts.
  • Attend industry events, conferences, and trade shows worldwide to network with key clients and stay informed about industry insights and developments.
  • Provide timely and accurate reports on key account performance, sales activity, and revenue forecasts within these regions to management.
  • Stay up-to-date on gambling regulations, compliance standards, and responsible gaming practices to ensure adherence and mitigate risks.


The ideal profile


We're on the lookout for someone who not only shares our values and ambitions but also envisions growing alongside MoveUp Media. As a dedicated team player, you embody fair play, transparency, agility, and an unstoppable drive. You're the perfect fit for our team if you:


  • Have outstanding written and verbal communication skills in Brazilian Portuguese and English.
  • Understand gambling products, platforms, and regulations in specific regions.
  • Drive change and support accounts in the iGaming industry with your sales skills.
  • Be ambitious, adaptable, and thrive in fast-paced environments.
  • Focus on exceeding sales targets and driving revenue growth.
  • Bring experience in iGaming strategy, sales, or affiliate management.
  • Excel in building and maintaining strong relationships with partners.
  • Possess excellent communication and negotiation skills.
  • Show active listening, resilience, and persistence.
  • Demonstrate strong problem-solving abilities and effective task coordination.
  • Excel in time management, organization, and planning.
  • Manage multiple accounts and tasks simultaneously.
  • Use analytical skills and a data-driven mindset for decision-making.
  • Thrive in teamwork and adapt well to evolving environments.
  • Be open to occasional travel for client meetings and industry events.


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • First Interview: A conversation with your future manager to ensure you meet the role’s requirements.
  • Second Interview: A chat with HR to understand you better and ensure a cultural fit with MoveUp Media.
  • Final Step: A proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • Remote Work Environment: Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely full-time.
  • Flexible Schedule: We measure results , not hours, and offer paid time off.
  • Development Opportunities: As a rapidly growing startup, we offer numerous possibilities for career advancement and support your career path.
  • Team Gatherings: Annual team get-togethers to connect, work, and have fun . We strive to find enjoyable spots for everyone.
  • Wellness Fund: €1,000 per year dedicated to your professional development, sports, or cultural events of your choice.

Para saber mais sobre a HST e sobre as nossas oportunidades, acesse:


Buscamos uma pessoa Analista de Operações – Suporte (Pleno) para se unir ao nosso Time de Operations para:

  • Criação, revisão e manutenção de materiais de treinamento e documentação técnica, garantindo padronização e atualização contínua;
  • Atendimentos a tickets de clientes nacionais e internacionais, atuando de forma autônoma na análise e resolução de incidentes;
  • Monitoramento de ambientes através do Zabbix e Grafana, realizando análises proativas e acionamentos preventivos quando necessário;
  • Condução de chamadas com clientes nacionais e internacionais para troubleshooting de tickets, realizando alinhamento técnico e definição de próximos passos;
  • Condução ou participação de reuniões de treinamento e/ou alinhamento da solução com clientes, fabricantes e parceiros, conforme a complexidade do tema;
  • Realizar análise, priorizar e abrir demandas técnicas para os times internos, acompanhando a evolução e garantindo retorno adequado ao cliente;
  • Realizar a instalação da solução e executar atualizações em ambientes de homologação e produção, seguindo procedimentos definidos e garantindo a estabilidade dos serviços;
  • Registrar, atualizar e acompanhar tickets, garantindo histórico técnico detalhado, comunicação adequada e cumprimento dos SLAs, mantendo o cliente informado sobre status, próximos passos e orientações;
  • Atuar em escalas de suporte estendido (24x7), incluindo atendimentos em finais de semana.


Acreditamos ser importante que você já tenha passado por algumas experiências e que também tenha os seguintes conhecimentos:

  • Experiência de pelo menos 2 anos atuando em sistemas operacionais Windows e Linux, com capacidade de análise;
  • Experiência em troubleshooting e análise de logs para diagnóstico e resolução de incidentes;
  • Experiência na área de softwares, atuando em configuração, manutenção e condução de treinamentos técnicos para clientes;
  • Experiência consolidada em suporte/operações no atendimento a clientes externos, nacionais ou internacionais;
  • Experiência ou vivência com ferramentas de monitoração de ambientes e serviços;
  • Experiência em atuação em ambientes produtivos, com foco em estabilidade, análise de impacto e mitigação de riscos;
  • Conhecimentos intermediários em redes e protocolos de segurança;

agents and LLM-powered workflows as part of the software development

lifecycle. This includes using agents to assist with design, implementation,

testing, debugging, and code quality while maintaining full ownership of

correctness and production readiness.

As a senior individual contributor, you will take ownership of systems end-to-end, influence architectural decisions, and help modernize the platform to meet growing business needs. Their goal is to break down language barriers worldwide via cutting-edge speech and language AI-powered solutions, such as video remote interpretation (VRI), over-the-phone interpretation (OPI), interpreter scheduling, simultaneous interpretation, and more.

Our client has remote teams across the U.S. as well as in Europe and the Philippines. The team is collaborative, inclusive, and highly engaged, with strong onboarding and growth support for new hires.

Requirements clarification

System design

Test creation and validation

Code review and quality improvement

Critically evaluate, challenge, and refine AI-generated outputs to ensure production-grade quality

Contribute to evolving best practices for agent-assisted development within the team

  • 8+ years of experience in back-end development using C#, .NET, Python, Node.js, or similar
  • Proven hands-on experience using agentic tools and development workflows in day-to-day software engineering

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Graphic Designer


Our Client is hiring a designer to support a high-output marketing team. This is not a brand-from-scratch role. The design system exists, and the job is to execute consistently, extend it intelligently, and keep things moving without hand-holding.


You’ll work directly with Marketing, with guidance from the Creative Director. Most of what you produce will show up in demand gen campaigns, event programs, and product marketing. It needs to look sharp, ship fast, and hold up across channels.


What you’ll do

  • You’ll be responsible for a wide range of design work tied directly to pipeline-driving campaigns
  • Create graphics for social, paid campaigns, email, and web
  • Design and iterate on landing pages in Webflow
  • Produce visual assets for webinars, virtual events, and campaigns
  • Design print collateral and occasional physical assets (including SWAG)
  • Create GIFs, motion elements, and lightweight animations
  • Edit video for social distribution and website use
  • Support ongoing campaign launches with fast-turn creative
  • This is a volume role, and you’ll be expected to make good decisions quickly and maintain quality under pace.


What matters in this role

  • You can operate inside an existing brand system without needing constant direction
  • You understand how design actually shows up in B2B marketing, not just how it looks in a portfolio
  • You’re comfortable moving between formats. Static, motion, web, video. No one is handing off perfect briefs every time
  • You have strong judgment about what’s “good enough to ship” vs what needs refinement
  • You can manage your own workflow and keep projects moving without bottlenecks


Requirements

  • 4+ years in a design role, ideally supporting marketing or growth teams
  • Strong portfolio that shows real campaign work, not just one-off visuals
  • Experience designing in Webflow (not just Figma concepts)
  • Experience with motion design and basic animation (GIFs, short-form video)
  • Video editing experience for social and web content
  • Fluency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite


Context for the work

Our client sells to B2B marketing teams running webinars and virtual events as part of pipeline generation. That means the creative you produce will be tied directly to:

  • Driving registrations and product demos
  • Increasing engagement
  • Supporting sales follow-up
  • Reinforcing brand credibility with senior marketing leaders

The output needs to feel polished, but it has to perform, not just look good.


What this is not

  • Not a pure brand exploration role
  • Not a pixel-perfect, weeks-per-project environment
  • Not isolated design work handed over a wall


You’ll be in the middle of campaigns, working closely with marketers who are moving fast and expect the same from you.


If that sounds like your kind of environment, this will be a good fit.

title: Brazil Senior Condition Intelligence (CI & PM)
description:
Company Description

Dingo Software is the global leader in predictive maintenance software for the mining industry, serving some of the world’s largest mining companies. We are best known for Driving efficiency, longevity and reliability for machines that matter. With 30+ years of asset health data, we're scaling rapidly under Riverside Company ownership to capture significant market opportunities.

Following recent investment from The Riverside Company, Dingo is executing an ambitious growth strategy. We're building world-class commercial capabilities to support this growth journey.


Role Description

As a Condition Intelligence (CI) Specialist at Dingo, you will be at the heart of delivering data-driven insights that help our clients across the Americas protect their most critical assets. Your mission is to transform fluid, sensor, and digital inspection data into clear, actionable recommendations that prevent mobile and fixed-plant breakdowns, extend component life, and eliminate unplanned downtime.

In this pivotal role, you will collaborate closely within then Dingo Technical Services team to monitor asset health remotely, assess component-level risk, and guide operational decisions that directly impact productivity, safety, and cost efficiency. You will be instrumental in harnessing Dingo’s advanced analytics and AI-driven capabilities to proactively engage client to identify risks before they escalate, ensuring consistently measurable results.

With a primary focus on our rapidly growing North and South American customer base, you will combine technical expertise with strong communication skills to deliver timely, trusted advice, strengthening long-term partnerships. In a mining sector increasingly focused on efficiency, sustainability, and predictive maintenance, your work will be a key driver in cementing Dingo’s reputation as the leader in asset health intelligence.


Condition Data Analysis & Diagnostics – Review and interpret condition management data from both mobile and fixed plant assets to diagnose component-level risks. Apply domain expertise to determine root causes, assess severity, and prioritize corrective actions based on operational impact, safety, and mission criticality.

Rules-Based Analytics Development – Create and refine rules-based analytics to enable swift detection of emerging issues. Ensure diagnostic models and alert parameters support early intervention, reducing downtime and extending component life.

Technical Support & Collaboration – Provide expert guidance to Dingo teams on component health assessments, lubrication strategies, and condition management best practices. Act as a trusted technical resource for troubleshooting and advanced diagnostics.

Customer Communication & Maintenance Recommendations – Follow up on flagged components or lubricant issues, translating complex technical data into clear, actionable maintenance recommendations for customers. Ensure communications are timely, accurate, and aligned with customer priorities.

Quality Observation Reviews – Deliver high-quality, daily observation reviews and actionable insights, consistently applying safety-first principles and considering operational mission criticality.

Data Accuracy & System Integrity – Monitor the condition management software database to ensure data accuracy, resolve discrepancies, and maintain the integrity of condition records.

Lubricated Component Health Assessment – Evaluate the condition of lubricated components to identify opportunities for extending asset life through on-condition maintenance changes.

Customer Engagement & Follow-Up – Organize and lead remote Condition Management follow-up meetings with customers and internal teams to confirm satisfaction, address concerns, and reinforce positive engagement experiences.

Diagnostic Tools & Guideline Development – Assist in developing structured diagnostic guidelines, contamination troubleshooting processes, and detailed repair procedures to support consistent, high-quality component health management.


Qualifications

Experience – Minimum of five (5) years’ experience in heavy industrial equipment maintenance within industrial or mining environments; OR a Mechanical or Mining Engineering degree with at least two (2) years of relevant experience. Hands-on background as a shop or field mechanic for industrial mining equipment is highly desirable.

Industry Knowledge – Strong familiarity with mining and industrial maintenance principles, including mechanical systems, equipment design, and repair processes.

Lubrication & Condition Monitoring Expertise – In-depth understanding of lubrication applications, maintenance principles, familiarity in onboard machine telemetry and/or OEM condition monitoring reporting systems, and the use of condition monitoring technologies and tools to inform proactive maintenance strategies.

Technical Proficiency – Proven ability to use data and factual analysis to troubleshoot issues, solve problems, and make informed operational decisions.

Linguistic Proficiency – Fluency in English is essential for clear and effective communication with customers and internal teams. A high degree of proficiency in Spanish or French is a strong advantage for engaging with a broader range of stakeholders.

Communication & Leadership – Excellent verbal and written communication skills, coupled with strong information management capabilities. Demonstrated ability to lead interactions with both internal teams and external customers, building trust and alignment.

Data Engineer / Senior Data Engineer

Location: Costa Rica, Brazil or Mexico

Focus: Digital & Customer Experience Applications


Role Summary

We are seeking a Data Engineer / Senior Data Engineer to design, build, and operate scalable data pipelines and curated datasets. This role is pivotal in enabling Digital and Customer Experience applications across our global enterprise. You will work hands-on with Python, PySpark, and Databricks, championing modern engineering practices through Git-based workflows, CI/CD, and Azure DevOps to ensure high-quality data delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Pipeline Development: Design and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines using Databricks and PySpark to transform and serve data for digital customer journeys.
  • Data Modeling: Build performant SQL transformations and curated dimensional data layers for downstream analytics and application consumption.
  • Engineering Excellence: Implement best practices for Databricks (notebooks vs. repos), modular code, cluster configuration, and cost-aware performance tuning.
  • Automation & Scripting: Utilize Python for data validation, orchestration helpers, and the creation of reusable libraries.
  • DevOps & CI/CD: * Manage source control via Git (GitHub/Bitbucket), enforcing strict PR reviews and branching strategies.
  • Build and maintain Azure DevOps pipelines to automate testing, packaging, and deployment across environments.
  • Quality & Reliability: Ensure data integrity through automated reconciliation checks, monitoring, and detailed operational runbooks.
  • Collaboration: Partner with product teams, analysts, and platform engineers to translate complex requirements into scalable data products.
  • Leadership (Senior Level): Lead module-level design, mentor junior engineers, and take ownership of critical pipeline delivery and enterprise code standards.


Technical Skills

Primary (Must-Have)

  • Advanced Data Engineering: Expert-level Python , PySpark , and SQL (advanced querying and optimization).
  • Databricks Ecosystem: Proficiency in Databricks jobs, workflows, clusters, and repos.
  • Version Control: Strong experience with Git (GitHub and/or Bitbucket) and enterprise branching workflows.
  • Azure DevOps: Hands-on experience with Boards, Repos, and Pipelines for build/release automation in data workloads.

Secondary (Good-to-Have)

  • Orchestration: Experience with Azure Data Factory (ADF) for ingestion and scheduling patterns.
  • Data Visualization: Understanding of Power BI datasets, measures, and refresh patterns to support analytics enablement.

title: .NET Developer
description:
Job Title:

Mid-Level .NET Developer (Backend / Distributed Systems)


Overview

We are seeking a mid-level .NET Developer to join a backend-focused engineering team building and enhancing distributed services in AWS. This role is heavily backend and API-driven, with a strong emphasis on asynchronous processing, system-to-system integration, and resilient service design. The engineer will work on both net-new services and enhancements to existing systems, collaborating closely with product owners and other engineering teams.


Key Responsibilities

• Design, build, and enhance backend services using .NET and C#

• Develop RESTful APIs and backend components that operate within distributed systems

• Build and maintain asynchronous processing workflows using messaging patterns

• Upgrade and modernize existing .NET applications (e.g. .NET 8 to .NET 10)

• Implement system-to-system integrations, including external-facing services

• Consume and process messages from event-driven sources, handling retries and failure scenarios

• Participate in unit and integration testing as part of CI/CD pipelines

• Deploy services to Kubernetes environments in AWS

• Collaborate with product owners, engineers, and cross-functional teams in a ticket-driven environment

• Contribute to design discussions with a system-wide, not just code-level, mindset


Technical Requirements

• Strong proficiency with C# and modern .NET development

• Experience building backend services and RESTful APIs

• Solid understanding of distributed systems and asynchronous processing

• Hands-on experience with event-driven architectures (pub/sub, messaging systems)

• Experience working in AWS environments

• Familiarity with Kubernetes-based deployments (e.g. EKS)

• Experience using relational databases (e.g. AWS RDS)

• Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, preferably GitHub Actions

• Experience with unit testing and integration testing in .NET applications


Preferred / Nice to Have

• Experience with AWS messaging services such as SNS and SQS

• Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform

• Experience deploying applications via GitHub Actions

• Exposure to configuration management patterns (e.g. externalized config services)

• Experience working alongside teams using different technology stacks (e.g. Clojure or functional programming environments)

• Familiarity with authentication and service-to-service security (e.g. Okta)

• Comfort using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot


Work Environment & Team Culture

• Backend-heavy role with minimal frontend expectations

• Collaborative, low-micromanagement engineering culture

• Engineers are expected to work independently but ask questions when needed

• Ticket-driven work with varying levels of requirement detail

• Strong emphasis on respectful cross-team collaboration

• Encouragement of thoughtful technical pushback and design discussions

• Regular pairing and open communication via Slack and ad-hoc calls

• Focus on sustainable delivery rather than perfection under time constraints


What Success Looks Like

• Quickly ramping into existing systems and development patterns

• Owning backend services end to end, from design through deployment

• Demonstrating a strong systems mindset beyond individual features

• Building reliable, maintainable services within a distributed architecture

• Collaborating effectively across teams with different technical bac

title: Senior Cloud Engineer (AWS and Azure)
description:
About the Company


Sycomp is a global IT services and logistics provider with extensive expertise in cloud, data center, endpoint management and security solutions. Sycomp’s diverse team of consultants and engineers deliver on the company’s mission to tackle challenging global IT projects through its state-of-the-art integration and warehouse centers and global technology partnerships. Headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, California, Sycomp has successfully shipped, deployed and managed complex IT projects and supporting assets in more than 150 countries helping its Fortune 500 customers and global partners realize a world without boundaries.



Position Overview:


We are seeking a motivated and results-oriented Senior Cloud Engineer with experience in two or more cloud technologies (AWS or Azure) to join our growing team in a support, engineering, and consulting role. In this role, you will work closely with our senior architects, engineers and consultants to assist clients in designing, implementing, and optimizing cloud-based solutions. This role offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in cloud architecture, develop technical expertise, and contribute to the success of our clients.


What You'll Do:


  • Manage and respond to customer-facing support tickets, ensuring timely resolution of technical issues and maintaining high customer satisfaction.
  • Collaborate with senior architects and consultants to understand client requirements and develop and support scalable cloud-based solutions.
  • Apply best practice framework principles to evaluate and improve client architecture.
  • Apply FinOps best practices to monitor, analyze, and optimize cloud costs, including cost allocation, budget tracking, and implementing cost-saving strategies.
  • Support and assist clients with AI/ML workloads and implementations using cloud provider services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Studio, Azure ML, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, and other AI tools.
  • Assist in designing, implementing, and maintaining cloud infrastructure components such as virtual compute instances (VMs & containers), storage services, databases, and virtual networks (VNet & VPC).
  • Provide technical support to clients, including troubleshooting issues, optimizing performance, and ensuring security best practices.
  • Configure and manage cloud resources, including virtual compute instances, storage services, databases, virtual networks, and more.
  • Develop and document infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools like Amazon CloudFormation & CDK, Azure ARM, Azure Bicap, Google Cloud Deployment Manager, or Terraform.
  • Contribute to DevOps workflows using tools such as Azure DevOps, Google Cloud Deployment and Amazon CodePipeline.
  • Maintain awareness and proficiency on cloud services, features, and best practices to provide expert guidance and support to clients.
  • Contribute to the development of documentation, training materials, and best practices guides for internal and external use.
  • Actively participate in professional development activities to enhance technical skills and knowledge of cloud technologies.


What We're Looking For:


  • Bachelor's or Technology degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • At least three years working in an AWS, Azure or Google Cloud environment.
  • At least one professional-level cloud certification such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer Professional, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert, Google Professional Cloud Architect, or Google Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer.
  • Strong understanding of core cloud provider services, including compute, networking, storage, database, and security.
  • Understanding of AWS, and Azure framework principles and practices.
  • Understanding of FinOps principles and cloud cost optimization best practices.
  • Basic understanding of AI/ML concepts and familiarity with AI tools and services.
  • Experience with ticketing systems and customer support workflows.
  • Basic knowledge of networking principles and protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP).
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Fluency in English, both written and verbal.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) tools.
  • Strong written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.


Bonus Points For:


  • Certifications in more than one cloud provider
  • FinOps Certified Practitioner or experience with cloud cost management tools.
  • Experience with cloud provider AI/ML services.
  • Experience conducting Well-Architected best-practice reviews.
  • Knowledge of DevOps principles and practices.
  • Experience in a technology consulting environment.
  • Experience with multiple cloud platforms.


What We Offer:


  • Collaborative and inclusive work culture with opportunities for growth and advancement.
  • Exciting projects with leading-edge cloud technologies.
  • Continuous learning and professional development opportunities including training and certification programs.


Join our team and embark on a rewarding career journey as a Cloud Engineer, where you will play a vital role in helping our clients succeed in the cloud. Apply now to become part of our innovative and dynamic team!

  • Projetar e implementar sistemas de agentes e multi-agentes, incluindo estruturas de supervisor, delegação de tarefas, memória e ferramentas;
  • Desenvolver fluxos complexos utilizando LangChain e LangGraph, aplicando boas práticas de composição, controle e observabilidade;
  • Integrar diferentes provedores de modelos (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, entre outros), escolhendo o melhor modelo para cada caso de uso;
  • Atuar na definição de estratégias de engenharia de prompt, avaliação de respostas, mitigação de alucinações e controle de qualidade;

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Fundamentos sólidos de IA aplicada e LLMs;
  • Engenharia de prompt (few-shot, chain-of-thought, structured output, function calling);
  • LangChain e seus principais conceitos (chains, tools, memory, retrievers);
  • LangGraph para orquestração de fluxos e agentes complexos;
  • Arquiteturas de agentes autônomos e multi-agentes, incluindo supervisor/worker;
  • Integração com APIs de LLMs (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude);
  • Design de APIs e serviços backend para consumo de IA;
  • Observabilidade aplicada a IA (logs, métricas, tracing, avaliação de respostas);

title: Analista de Marca e Conteúdo | Brand & Content Analyst
description:
About Downtown Engineers

Downtown Engineers (DWT ENG) is a New York-based MEP (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing) engineering firm trusted by architecture offices, developers and national brands.


Our work spans from franchise rollouts for brands like McDonald's, Domino's and Dunkin' to hospitality projects with Hilton and Hyatt, healthcare and residential buildings across the United States, with a strong focus on New York City.

We're a remote-first team of 20+ people across different countries, with 300+ projects delivered across 16+ sectors. Our culture is grounded in trust, transparency and autonomy and that's how we communicate too.


About the Opportunity

We're looking for a hands-on Brand & Content Analyst to help us build and sustain our authority in the market. This role sits at the intersection of brand, education and demand generation, creating content that builds trust with architects and developers before the first conversation ever happens.


The ideal candidate is content-obsessed with a strong brand lens, someone who takes one idea and immediately sees multiple formats, narratives and distribution paths. Beyond producing content, you'll ensure that everything Downtown puts out communicates the brand clearly and consistently.

You'll work closely with leadership, transforming technical knowledge into high-quality content, while reviewing and strengthening how the brand shows up across every touchpoint.


Compensation & Structure

  • Full-time contractor (remote)
  • Fixed monthly compensation
  • Please include your compensation expectation in BRL (R$) in your application


What you’ll do


1.Content & channels

  • Produce and distribute content across priority channels (LinkedIn, email, blog and future channels)
  • Write copy, adapt templates, collaborate on visuals and test new formats
  • Coordinate editorial calendar, approvals and publishing


2.Brand consistency & messaging

  • Review and propose copy for the website, social media pages, presentations, events, campaigns and sales materials, ensuring brand clarity and tone across all touchpoints
  • Research best practices and propose improvements to how Downtown communicates across channels
  • Be the first line of quality control on how the brand shows up externally


3.Demand generation & sales enablement

  • Create rich content (case studies, guides, studies, infographics) to educate architects and drive inbound demand
  • Support sales with enablement materials and educational assets
  • Help build Downtown's educational and thought leadership initiatives


4.Optimization & performance

  • Ensure content is evergreen, performance-driven and SEO-friendly
  • Track results, test improvements and iterate


Requirements


Must-haves

  • Fluent English (written and spoken). Day-to-day communication is mostly in Portuguese as the Marketing team is entirely Brazilian. However, all official written communication and some of our meetings are conducted fully in English
  • Strong writing and content creation skills
  • Hands-on execution mindset with high autonomy, curiosity and ownership
  • Ability to think in formats, distribution and repurposing and not just write and post
  • Comfortable working with multiple channels and priorities without losing consistency
  • Experience with content marketing or B2B communication
  • Strong sense of brand consistency: you notice when messaging, tone or visuals feel off, you act on it. And you also proactively propose improvements


Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with SEO, content optimization or marketing automation tools
  • Experience in technical, engineering or architecture-related industries


Selection Process

  • Apply to the opportunity, submitting the form with your CV and English experience
  • Screening: English and communication assessment (video)
  • Technical challenge
  • Interviews with leadership
  • Offer


Why join Downtown?

  • Role with direct business impact
  • Work with top architects and U.S. brands
  • Fast-moving, low-bureaucracy culture with real autonomy
  • High growth opportunity as the company scales

title: Analista de Growth Marketing | Growth Marketing Analyst
description:
About Downtown Engineers

Downtown Engineers (DWT ENG) is a New York-based MEP (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing) engineering firm trusted by architecture offices, developers and national brands. We're a remote-first team of 20+ people across different countries, with 300+ projects delivered across 16+ sectors. Our culture is grounded in trust, transparency and autonomy, and that's how we communicate too.


About the Opportunity

Downtown is growing and we need someone to build and run the marketing infrastructure that supports it. As a Growth Marketing Analyst, you'll work across three fronts — recurrent clients, referrals and new client acquisition —designing strategies, setting up campaigns, configuring tools and measuring what converts. Your primary focus is on capture and expansion (website, CRM, events, paid media, referral systems, client retention), while supporting the demand layer fed by content and authority.


This role works in close partnership with leadership and sales. You'll think about where to invest and how to grow, then make it happen, connecting marketing efforts to pipeline, testing what works, cutting what doesn't and scaling what proves itself.


Compensation & Structure

  • Full-time contractor (remote)
  • Fixed monthly compensation
  • Please include your compensation expectation in BRL (R$) in your application


What you’ll do


1.Channel oversight & growth

  • Set and track channel-level goals aligned with Downtown's growth priorities: recurrent clients, referrals and new client acquisition
  • Own the day-to-day management and growth of marketing channels — email, paid media, outbound, events and future channels
  • Plan, execute and optimize paid campaigns, including budget management and audience targeting
  • Support the design and execution of outbound and ABM initiatives
  • Optimize website performance as a conversion engine — landing pages, CTAs, user flow and lead capture
  • Monitor organic search performance and identify SEO opportunities to support inbound growth
  • Propose and test new campaigns, formats and acquisition strategies to improve performance


2.CRM & automation

  • Own the marketing layer of the CRM (Zoho) in partnership with sales: segmentation, audience lists, campaign tagging and marketing lifecycle tracking
  • Handle the technical setup and configuration of marketing platforms and integrations
  • Build and manage email marketing flows — nurture sequences, newsletters, re-engagement campaigns and event-driven communications


3.Reporting & optimization

  • Track and report on channel performance, campaign results and growth metrics
  • Run experiments, analyze data and translate findings into actionable improvements
  • Monitor referral and client retention metrics, supporting sales with data-driven insights


Requirements


Must-haves

  • Fluent English (written and spoken). Day-to-day communication is mostly in Portuguese as the Marketing team is entirely Brazilian. However, all official written communication and some of our meetings are conducted fully in English
  • Analytical mindset with comfort in data, dashboards and performance reporting
  • Hands-on execution mindset with high autonomy, curiosity and ownership
  • Experience with B2B marketing and demand generation
  • Working knowledge of CRM platforms (Zoho, HubSpot, Salesforce or similar)
  • Experience building and managing email marketing flows and automation
  • Hands-on experience with paid media (LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads or similar platforms)


Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with Account-Based Marketing (ABM)
  • Experience with marketing automation tools beyond email (e.g., workflow builders, lead scoring)
  • Familiarity with the architecture, engineering or construction industry


Selection Process

  • Apply to the opportunity, submitting the form with your CV and English experience
  • Screening: English and communication assessment (video)
  • Technical challenge
  • Interviews with leadership
  • Offer


Why join Downtown?

  • Role with direct business impact
  • Work with top architects and U.S. brands
  • Fast-moving, low-bureaucracy culture with real autonomy
  • High growth opportunity as the company scales

title: AI Performance Creative Designer (Streetwear/Exotic Cars)
description:
So… what the hell is Ark Exotic?

Ark Exotic is where founders and creatives who've already made it come to gather and access our fleet.


Our members have driven everything. The novelty is gone. What they're chasing now is the social moments that they can't find anywhere else. We want to build a world of underground luxury that feel like scenes from a film.


Now we're building a creative team to match and we need an AI-native performance designer who can sell the feeling of being inside Ark.


What You'll Do

  • Design performance creatives that feel like film stills, not ads
  • Generate scroll-stopping visuals that pull our target deeper into the world (and the funnel)
  • Build on-image copy that speaks to a young successful founders
  • Maintain a visual language across motorsport, lifestyle, clothing, and brand storytelling pillars
  • Move fast — produce cinematic visuals at the volume performance marketing demands


Who You Are

  • We don't care about your years of experience. We care about your eye and what you've built.
  • You've built performance ads for premium DTC, lifestyle, or fashion brands before
  • You've mastered Freepik Spaces, Higgsfield, Runway, Midjourney, and OpenAI's Image 2
  • You understand the difference between \"looks expensive\" and \"feels exclusive\"
  • Your portfolio looks like an A24 mood board, not a Canva carousel
  • You've created something of your own — a brand, a zine, a film, a photo series, a fit page that proves you don't need a brief to build a world
  • You follow filmmakers, fashion houses, and underground car culture in equal measure
  • Streetwear, automotive, fashion, or film background? You're already shortlisted.
  • You can tell me without thinking why the Gentle Monster \"Hunt\" campaign works, or why a single shot of a wet parking lot at night can carry an entire brand


What We're Building

  • The most-watched private world in luxury automotive. Members don't join for the cars. They join for the access, the people, and the feeling of being on the inside of something most people will never see.
  • This role defines what that world looks like to anyone discovering us for the first time. Your work will be the first impression for people who've never been impressed.


What We're Offering

  • Competitive salary based on your portfolio
  • 10 days PTO per year
  • Path to grow into creative lead / brand director as we scale
  • Fully remote


How to Apply

  • A portfolio showing off your streetwear / midnight club design language
  • A short paragraph on how you'd approach the visual feel of an Ark Exotic ad campaign


If the interview goes well, we hire on the call. Welcome to Ark.

title: Engenheiro de processos
description:
Resumo da Posição


O Engenheiro de Processos II – Completions é responsável por planejar, otimizar e garantir a eficiência dos processos operacionais dentro da linha de produto de Completions. Atua como suporte técnico estratégico às operações, assegurando a qualidade do serviço, conformidade com normas internacionais (API/ISO) e promovendo a melhoria contínua, contribuindo diretamente para a excelência operacional e resultados do negócio.


Responsabilidades


  • Planejar, implementar e otimizar processos operacionais, garantindo qualidade na execução e cumprimento das metas organizacionais de forma eficiente e eficaz.
  • Avaliar, monitorar e melhorar continuamente a eficiência dos processos e procedimentos do Plano de Controle Operacional e do Plano de Qualidade de Serviço, promovendo ganhos de qualidade, produtividade e performance.
  • Fornecer suporte técnico às equipes operacionais de Completions e aos clientes, atuando como referência em processos, desempenho operacional e solução de problemas.
  • Realizar e participar de auditorias operacionais, assegurando conformidade com padrões API Q1, API Q2 e ISO 9001, além de apoiar auditorias internas e externas relacionadas à qualidade e processos.
  • Apoiar e, quando necessário, liderar investigações de falhas operacionais (eventos PC2 e PC3), conduzindo análise de causa raiz, garantindo documentação adequada e comunicação conforme fluxo estabelecido.
  • Elaborar, revisar e padronizar instruções técnicas de trabalho (Work Instructions), procedimentos operacionais e demais documentos técnicos, assegurando aderência às políticas e requisitos corporativos.
  • Atuar na gestão da qualidade e confiabilidade, por meio de análise de desempenho de processos, equipamentos e ativos, identificando tendências, desvios e riscos operacionais, e implementando ações preventivas e corretivas.
  • Apoiar a gestão e desenvolvimento de fornecedores, garantindo alinhamento com requisitos técnicos, operacionais e de qualidade.
  • Identificar e implementar oportunidades de melhoria contínua, utilizando metodologias estruturadas (Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, entre outras).
  • Garantir o cumprimento das diretrizes de QHSE, promovendo uma cultura de segurança, qualidade e integridade operacional, incluindo suporte à gestão de treinamentos conforme matrizes internas e requisitos de clientes.



Requisitos


  • Formação superior em Engenharia (Mecânica, Produção, Petróleo ou áreas correlatas).
  • Experiência prévia em operações de Oil & Gas.
  • Vivência de 1 a 2 anos em qualidade e processos, com atuação em tratativa de não conformidades, análise de dados e suporte à operação.
  • Conhecimento em processos operacionais, melhoria contínua e análise de desempenho.
  • Familiaridade com normas e padrões de qualidade (API Q1, API Q2, ISO 9001).
  • Experiência com investigação de falhas e análise de causa raiz (RCA, 5 Porquês, Ishikawa) e metodologias de confiabilidade (FMEA, RCM, FRACAS ou similares).
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de melhoria contínua (Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, etc.) será considerado um diferencial.
  • Inglês avançado (desejável, conforme interface com times globais).
  • Habilidade analítica, com forte orientação para solução de problemas e melhoria de processos.
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de atuar em equipes multidisciplinares.
  • Experiência prévia em confiabilidade e/ou formação específica na área será considerada um diferencial.
  • Vivência em auditorias internas e/ou externas.
  • Conhecimento nos softwares BlockSim e Weibull++ será considerado um diferencial.

title: Veeva Support Analyst
description:
Required Skills & Experience

• Strong technical skills in configuration, and issue resolution in Windows-based enterprise environments.

• Familiarity with ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow) and Request/ incident/change management processes.

• Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have Skills & Experience


• Experience with documentation tools and version control systems is a plus.


Job Description


A large pharmaceutical client is looking for Veeva Support Analyst to join their team. This role provides comprehensive technical support and system management across multiple regulatory and document management platforms. Responsibilities include end-to-end support (L1–L3) for Veeva RIM and Veeva SafetyDocs Vaults, encompassing issue diagnosis, resolution tracking, and proactive monitoring. The position collaborates with BOT development teams to deliver Veeva RIM API endpoints for automation and integration, and contributes to configuring the Veeva RIM Trainings module within the eLMS Quality Suite to ensure streamlined compliance tracking. Acting as the technical point of contact for PleaseReview (both standalone and Veeva-integrated), the role manages user access, configuration, performance optimization, and license administration. Additional duties include setup and maintenance of ISI Toolbox, lifecycle management of Lorenz docuBridge (including user provisioning and licensing), and support for Lorenz iSubmit installation, configuration, and issue resolution to meet submission standards. The role also involves configuring Word Templates for regulatory workflows, installing and troubleshooting iLovePDF and other document processing tools for high-volume submissions, and managing ServiceNow Request and Incident tickets to ensure timely resolution of customer escalations. This is a remote opportunity in LATAM, working US ET hours.
